title: Dragonfly in Amber
author: Diana Gabaldon
summary: Claire, back in the 1960s, tells of her years in 1740s Paris and Scotland with Jamie, as they try to stop the Jacobite rising that she knows will end at Culloden.
readIf: you liked Outlander and want more of Claire and Jamie's story.
skipIf: you have not read the first book or find a near thousand-page novel daunting.
